title: Reduplicative constructions in Mandarin: Socio-emotional profiling through distributional semantics
abstract: arXiv:2609.16860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mandarin Chinese has two productive reduplicative constructions that repeat either two-character base words or their constituents (e.g., `in good health', `discuss a bit'). Their varied meanings have been described as realizing plurality, valence coloring, sound symbolism and pragmatic functions. The aim of this study is twofold. A first goal is to clarify whether it is possible to come to a more precise understanding of the variegated semantics of Mandarin reduplication by using word embeddings from distributional semantics. A second goal is to explore how useful embeddings are for understanding the details of a semantically complex word-formation process. We show that the embedding space recovers the semantic and grammatical properties of reduplications previously identified in the literature, validating Tencent embeddings for morphological investigation. translated_title: 汉语重叠构式：基于分布语义学的社会情感特征分析
translated_abstract: 汉语中有两种能产的重叠构式，它们重复双字基词或其组成成分（例如“健康”、“讨论”）。这些重叠式的多样语义被描述为体现复数意义、效价色彩、语音象征和语用功能。本研究有双重目标。第一个目标是阐明是否可以借助分布语义学的词嵌入技术，对汉语重叠式多样化的语义获得更精确的理解。第二个目标是探索词嵌入在理解这一语义复杂的构词过程的细节方面有多大用处。我们表明，词嵌入空间能够恢复先前文献中已识别的重叠式的语义和语法属性，验证了腾讯词嵌入在形态学研究中的有效性。语义特征分析显示，重叠构式通常与社会情感内容有强烈的关联。
tldr: 本研究利用分布语义学的词嵌入技术分析汉语重叠构式，验证了词嵌入空间能够捕捉重叠式的语义与语法特征，并揭示重叠构式具有显著的社会情感色彩。
en_tdlr: This study employs distributional semantic word embeddings to analyze Mandarin reduplicative constructions, validating that embedding spaces recover their semantic and grammatical properties and revealing their strong socio-emotional coloring.
